title: git-test-repositories says git checkout and git switch skip die_if_checked_out when the main worktree's HEAD is a symref to the branch, but the check reads the current worktree's HEAD
goal: kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md's 'In use is wider' fact says only what builtin/checkout.c's die_if_switching_to_a_branch_in_use at v2.55.0 does: it returns early when the current worktree's HEAD already is the branch, so in a linked worktree a branch held only by the main worktree still dies

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md's 'In use is wider' fact says only what builtin/checkout.c's die_if_switching_to_a_branch_in_use at v2.55.0 does: it returns early when the current worktree's HEAD already is the branch (get_main_ref_store reads the current worktree's gitdir; its comment: 'bypassed when the branch is already the current one'), so in a linked worktree a branch held only by the main worktree still dies.
